finalText:
That's already in there too — no change needed.

`src/router.js`: on every event it checks `lastSeenByKey[key]`; if the new event is < 5 minutes after the last one with that key, it returns `[]` (dropped). Confirmed passing in `verify.js` (`'a repeat two minutes later drops'`, `'repeats are dropped at every priority'`).

Router already covers all four rules — quiet hours, critical pages, high fans to sms+email, 5-minute repeat suppression. Nothing left to implement unless you've got a new rule.
